video.title: Speediance Partner Custom Workouts Are Finally Here
video.description:
Speediance quietly added Partner Custom Workouts in a routine software update—and it may be the biggest improvement to the machine since I got it.

I show where the new Solo or Partner option appears, how to add another logged-in user, and why letting a partner join custom and AI-generated workouts matters. I also cover the Pilates rollout and the cable-position guidance that disappeared in the same software update.

No major announcement. No press release. Just a major new feature, plus one frustrating interface change.

Visit Toby on Fitness Tech: https://tobyonfitnesstech.com
